snippet.title: Down the Trench - Attack on the Doomstar!: Playthrough
snippet.description:
Attack on the Doomstar! (c) Antic Publishing 1987 for the Atari 8 bit line of computers

Another simple tech demo turned into game, and from the same programmer responsbile for Attack on the Death Star. And just like that one, this attempt at a game sucks too, for the same reasons.

Using the Atari800Win PLus emulator (http://www.a800win.atari-area.prv.pl) with standard Atari 800XL settings (XL/XE with BASIC / 64kB RAM / PAL mode).
